subject.title: improve(mattermost): restart only the changed account on config reload

question: Should `reload.accountScopedRestart` become a supported long-term `ChannelPlugin` capability, with Mattermost as its first and currently sole opt-in?
rationale: The patch is mechanically coherent, but this boolean governs whether core may narrow lifecycle operations based on a plugin's isolation claim; that permanent plugin API boundary needs maintainer intent rather than an automated repair decision.

options.title: Adopt the scoped-reload capability
options.body: Approve the documented opt-in contract and land this PR with Mattermost as the only initial adopter while other channels retain wholesale reloads.

options.title: Keep reload granularity private for now
options.body: Pause this PR and define a narrower internal or plugin-artifact design before exposing a reusable channel-plugin capability.

options.title: Defer the feature
options.body: Leave wholesale reload behavior unchanged until maintainers want to own a multi-channel scoped-lifecycle contract.

recommendation.title: Adopt the scoped-reload capability
recommendation.body: Approve the documented opt-in contract and land this PR with Mattermost as the only initial adopter while other channels retain wholesale reloads.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged ownership of the current gateway reload transaction path and direct rebase discussion make this the strongest available routing candidate.
